Process a reference file that contains operations or data to be automatically
executed.

Reference files support three formats:
  1. operations: List of operations (create, update, delete, get, list)
  2. data: List of objects to create
  3. template: Template with variables to expand and create

  Process operations from a reference file
  zqk internal process --file operations.yaml
  Process data from a reference file
  zqk internal process --file data.yaml
  Process template with variables
  zqk internal process --file template.yaml
  Dry-run to see what would be executed
  zqk internal process --file operations.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk internal process --file <reference-file> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be executed without actually executing
      --file string             Path to reference file (required)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
